Personality: Sauromates, a prominent figure of the Iazyges, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Sauromates owes allegiance to the Sarmatian & Scythian Nomads, hailing from the noble house of Iazyges. Historical Record: A kinsman of Banadaspos, head of the Iazyges, a Sarmatian house of Sarmatia. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
